solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Asian navies meet at sea

indicators.note: being at sea means confused or all over the place, so the letters are muddled into a new order

explanation.surface: Ships of several navies gather together on the ocean.
explanation.walkthrough: 'At sea' looks like the setting for the navies but is the anagram signal on NAVIES MEET.
explanation.definitionFit: A person from Vietnam, a country in South-East Asia, is an Asian.

clue.text: One in leading position is full of himself

indicators.note: the word in shows that one item is placed within the other

parts.note: the van is the foremost part of an army or movement
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone at the front, at the top, is conceited.
explanation.definitionFit: A vain person is conceited, with an inflated view of their own worth.

clue.text: Note hip seams split by stress

parts.note: E is a musical note

indicators.note: being split means broken apart, so these letters are scattered and reformed

explanation.surface: A tailor observes that hip seams have burst under strain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Split' rearranges HIP SEAMS into MPHASISE after E.
explanation.definitionFit: To stress a point is to emphasise it, giving it prominence.

clue.text: Well-known to have made a record

definitions.meaning: having written something down, as a note

explanation.definitionFit: Noted means famous; it is also the past tense of a verb for jotting down.

clue.text: The male sort — it includes females as well

parts.note: a man is a male
a sort is a kind

explanation.surface: A remark that the masculine type also takes in women.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface jokes on the word for humanity starting with a word for a male.
explanation.definitionFit: The human race as a whole, embracing both sexes, is meant here.

clue.text: Main plant producing wonder in children

indicators.note: in shows one word is placed inside the other

parts.note: seed means offspring or descendants
awe is a feeling of wonder

explanation.surface: A big factory makes children marvel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Main' looks like chief and 'plant' like a factory, but the main is the sea and the plant one that grows in it.
explanation.definitionFit: The main is an old term for the ocean, so a marine plant such as kelp fits.

clue.text: Important people will turn to a shady character

indicators.note: turning round means the word for important people is read from its end back to its start

parts.note: VIPs are very important persons

explanation.surface: A warning that the great and good will go bad and become crooks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Will turn' reverses VIPS. A SPIV is British slang for a flashy petty crook dealing in black-market goods.
explanation.definitionFit: Spiv is British slang for a small-time swindler or black-market trader, a shady type.

clue.text: Former holy man

definitions.meaning: a monk heading a religious house

explanation.definitionFit: Prior means previous; it is also a monastic superior below an abbot.

clue.text: A number are eating fresh vegetables and fruit

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral five

indicators.note: fresh means new, so the letters take a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Several people are tucking into fresh produce.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fresh' looks like it describes the vegetables, but rearranges ARE EATING.
explanation.definitionFit: Meat-free food made only of plant produce is called this, loosely defined by example.

clue.text: Trampled on Oriental in mad rush

parts.note: trampled means stamped on
E stands for east, the Orient

explanation.surface: People were trodden underfoot in a frenzied charge.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden panicked rush of a crowd or herd is a stampede.

clue.text: Insertion of data is not out of place

parts.note: a batsman who is not out is still in, as in cricket
to place something is to put it

explanation.surface: Someone insists that entering data is perfectly appropriate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not out of place' reads as one phrase meaning suitable; 'not out' is a cricket term for a batsman still at the crease.
explanation.definitionFit: In computing, input is the data fed into a system, so the act of entering it.

clue.text: Even the short-sighted could plainly see that it was dangerous

definitions.text: Even the short-sighted could plainly see that it was dangerous

parts.words: Even the short-sighted could plainly see that it was dangerous
parts.note: a narrow escape was close up, so near that even someone with poor distance vision could see it; a close call is a narrow miss

explanation.surface: A hazard so obvious that anyone, however poor their eyesight, would notice it.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue plays on short-sighted people seeing only things close by: a narrow escape is literally a thing that was near.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrow escape from danger or a close call is called by this idiom.

clue.text: Policy that's uncompromising is almost a shame

indicators.note: almost means the phrase is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: hard lines is a British exclamation meaning bad luck, what a shame

explanation.surface: Someone laments that a rigid policy is nearly a disgrace.
explanation.walkthrough: HARD LINES, British for 'bad luck', loses its last letter to 'almost'.
explanation.definitionFit: A firm stance that refuses concessions on a policy is known as taking this line.

clue.text: Worth millions, weary, needing to retire

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for million or millions

indicators.note: retiring means withdrawing backwards, so the word for weary is turned round

parts.note: to weary is to tire

explanation.surface: A millionaire, exhausted, is ready to stop working.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Needing to retire' looks like an old worker's plight but is the reversal signal on the weary word.
explanation.definitionFit: Worth and merit are synonyms for the value or excellence that deserves praise.

clue.text: This old boneshaker, strangely loved piece

indicators.note: strangely means in an odd way, so the letters are rearranged oddly

explanation.surface: An old bicycle described affectionately as a cherished item.
explanation.walkthrough: A boneshaker is an early bicycle with solid tyres.
explanation.definitionFit: An early pedal bicycle, nicknamed for its rough ride, is a velocipede.

clue.text: Forced to seek a new occupation

definitions.text: Forced to seek a new occupation

parts.words: Forced to seek a new occupation
parts.note: occupation here means occupying a home, not a job: tenants thrown out of their house must find another

explanation.surface: Someone sacked and made to look for a different job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Occupation' suggests employment, but it means the occupancy of a dwelling.
explanation.definitionFit: Tenants who are legally expelled from a property must find somewhere else to live.

clue.text: Complete, from start to finish, hiding nothing

indicators.note: hiding means holding something within, so the other piece goes inside

parts.note: through means from beginning to end
O is the figure nought, nothing

explanation.surface: A full account that conceals nothing from beginning to end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hiding' puts O inside THROUGH, though the surface seems to deny any concealment.
explanation.definitionFit: Thorough means complete and exhaustive, with nothing left out.

clue.text: One who treats wounds — in the chest?

definitions.meaning: someone who dresses wounds, applying bandages
a sideboard or chest of drawers with shelves for crockery

explanation.walkthrough: The dash and question mark hint that the same word names a piece of furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: A dresser applies dressings to wounds; it is also a kitchen cabinet with shelves.

clue.text: Gels put on one side for repairs

parts.note: a jelly that gels sets
right is one side, as opposed to left

explanation.surface: Hair gels are put to one side while fixing something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put on' is a link word placing one piece before the other; 'Gels' suggests hair products but is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To set something right is to correct or mend it.

clue.text: Individual with sour disposition that is hard to bear

parts.note: a single individual is one

indicators.note: a disposition is an arrangement, so the letters of sour are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: Describes a grumpy person who is a burden to put up with.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Disposition' looks like temperament but signals an arrangement of SOUR into ROUS.
explanation.definitionFit: An onerous task is burdensome, a heavy load that is difficult to endure.

clue.text: Start of court proceedings

parts.note: suggests a legal hearing, but in tennis each point on court starts with this stroke

explanation.surface: Describes the opening of a lawsuit.
explanation.walkthrough: The court is a tennis court; serving also begins a lawsuit when papers are delivered.
explanation.definitionFit: In tennis the serve starts each point played on court.

clue.text: Unusually, I earn it in doing nothing

indicators.note: unusually means in an unusual way, so the letters are set out differently

explanation.surface: Someone is surprised to be paid while being idle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unusually' rearranges I EARN IT.
explanation.definitionFit: Inertia is inactivity, a tendency to stay idle and not move.

clue.text: It's reported to stimulate comprehension

indicators.note: reported means spoken, so the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: to stimulate is to incite

explanation.surface: Someone claims a thing provokes understanding.
explanation.definitionFit: Insight is deep understanding or perception of something.

clue.text: Girl has half-hour in a state

parts.note: Ida is a girl's name

indicators.note: half of the word hour is its first two letters

explanation.surface: A young woman is in a nervous state for thirty minutes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Half-hour' looks like thirty minutes but means half the word HOUR.
explanation.definitionFit: Idaho is one of the fifty United States, in the north-west.

clue.text: A bluff upstanding moral story-teller

indicators.note: in a down clue, upstanding means the word reads upwards, backwards

parts.note: to bluff is to pose, putting on a false front

explanation.surface: A frank, upright man of principle who tells tales.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Upstanding' looks like honourable but reverses POSE in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient Greek fabulist's fables each end with a moral.

clue.text: Two girls that could be useful in the kitchen

definitions.text: that could be useful in the kitchen

parts.note: Rose is a girl's name
Mary is another girl's name

explanation.surface: A pair of young women who would be handy helpers when cooking.
explanation.walkthrough: The kitchen use is as a herb for flavouring food.
explanation.definitionFit: This aromatic herb is commonly used for seasoning in cooking, as with roast lamb.

clue.text: Decoration badly made by learner

indicators.note: badly means made poorly, so the letters are put together wrongly

parts.note: L is for learner, as on British L-plates

explanation.surface: An award was poorly crafted by a novice.
explanation.definitionFit: A medal is a decoration awarded for service or achievement.

clue.text: Produce disorder, wake up in prison

explanation.walkthrough: Three meanings; 'in' links the last, as in the phrase 'in stir'.
explanation.definitionFit: Stir means cause trouble, rouse from sleep, and is slang for jail.

clue.text: Calm and painless death

parts.note: something painless is easy
going is a euphemism for dying, a passing

explanation.surface: Someone hopes for a peaceful, untroubled end.
explanation.definitionFit: A relaxed, placid temperament that is not easily upset is described this way.

clue.text: Understand it is a number less than ten

parts.note: dig is slang for understand or appreciate

explanation.surface: Someone is asked to grasp that the figure is a single figure.
explanation.definitionFit: A digit is any single numeral from zero to nine.

clue.text: First showing of estate agent's notice

indicators.note: the first showing of a word is its initial letter

parts.note: a secret agent is a spy

explanation.surface: Describes an early viewing of a property advertised by an estate agent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Estate agent' reads as one profession, but 'estate' gives only its initial and 'agent' is a SPY.
explanation.definitionFit: To espy is to catch sight of, to spot or observe.

clue.text: Fan of sickness benefit?

parts.note: reads as an enthusiast for welfare payments, but describes a fan (air-blower), and also a breathing machine that benefits the sick

explanation.surface: Someone who keenly supports state payments to the ill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fan' means a device moving air, not an admirer; the hospital breathing machine helps the sick.
explanation.definitionFit: A device that circulates air is a fan; one that keeps patients breathing aids the ill.
